sloka: स सागरं घूर्णितवीचिमालं तदा भृशं भ्रामितसर्वसत्त्वम्।समीक्षमाणः सहसा जगाम चक्रं यथा विष्णुकराग्रमुक्तम् ।। ६.७४.५२ ।।
transliteration: sa sāgaraṁ ghūrṇitavīcimālaṁ tadā bhṛśaṁ bhrāmitasarvasattvam।samīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā jagāma cakraṁ yathā viṣṇukarāgramuktam ।। 6.74.52 ।।

translations.english: Watching the mountains, trees, birds, rivers, tanks, the best of cities, all of them and prosperous people, he went at his father's speed.
